question: Can the proposed descending additive packet writer with at most two distinct working signs per numeric value cover the retained whole daldy?
basis: Known-countercase screening during design, not a prospectively blinded experiment. Root read the complete producer note and claim-bearing GDT1208 and GDT1232 reports; GDT1198 contexts and exact daldy profile were read in the same work block.
root_proof: Write w(s) for the fixed numeric value of working sign s.
The first four working signs of the retained complete group daldy impose w(d)>=w(a)>=w(l)>=w(d).
Antisymmetry of the numeric order forces w(d)=w(a)=w(l).
d,a,l are three distinct units in the stipulated working inventory. They cannot all belong to a value class of size at most two.
Renaming the working units bijectively does not change the three distinct units or the repeated endpoint. No choice of the final y value or source-letter target repairs this contradiction.

retained_exact_form_account.common_witness: f45r.10 G006; same line also contains distinct standalone dalor and dal. Readers are alternate transcriptions of one manuscript, not independent witnesses.
retained_exact_form_account.limits: Counts concern admitted raw standalone forms, not the stricter GDT1233 subset. Embedded daldaldy and reader-divergent joins are not pooled. No word meaning is assigned.

assumptions: One retained whole group is one ordinary additive packet.
The working units d,a,l are distinct signs with stable numeric values.
At most two distinct working signs share each value.
scope_and_predecessors: This is the modern sorted two-form construction, not an attested historical complete cipher.
GDT1232 already excludes the different distinct-value Abjad contract. This consequence uses neither that value pool nor its solver.
The earlier IDEA940 countercase uses three terminal classes among daldy/dalor/dal and remains a different failed model.
General shared-value additive arithmetic in GDT1231, the historical letter example in IDEA959, and the conditional singleton floor in IDEA964 retain their original statuses.
The manuscript working inventory, word boundaries and visual comparison are not proven alphabetic/semantic facts.
